name: WhoKnew Views – View Counter & Social Proof for WooCommerce
author: WhoKnew.io

sections.description:
WooCommerce view counter + social proof plugin — display real-time product views on your store.

Why stores use social proof tools like view counters:

  • Shoppers often trust products with high engagement signals like reviews or view counts
  • Social proof implementations can help increase conversions
  • Async tracking and optimized queries help minimize performance impact

Free Features (Instant Setup)

  • Accurate view counter for every product
  • Full visual customization (colors, fonts, animations, borders, shadows)
  • Live preview system for instant testing
  • 100+ professional CSS examples — continually growing collection (Luxury, Hover Effects, 3D, Animations, Elite)
  • 5 icon libraries (Font Awesome, Ionicons, Elegant, Dripicons, Dashicons)
  • Bot filtering + IP whitelist
  • Mobile-responsive display
  • 5-year data retention
  • Product leaderboard with growth badges

Pro Features ($79/year)

  • AI forecasting (Meta Prophet) — predict viral products up to 90 days early
  • Smart view padding (15 presets) — fix “cold start” problem
  • Email alerts for view spikes
  • Export reports (CSV + images)
  • Priority support

No coding. Works with any WooCommerce theme.

– Pro version includes audio files in the plugin package (no external download required)
sections.installation:
1. Upload whoknew-views folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce > WhoKnew Views to configure
  4. Pro: Enter license from whoknew.io
sections.faq:
Is this a WooCommerce view counter?

Yes — tracks real product page views and displays them with social proof.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin uses async tracking and daily aggregation to minimize performance impact. View tracking runs in the background and is designed to have minimal effect on your site speed or performance.

How to show view counter on product pages?

Enable in styling tab → choose position (no coding required)

Can I customize or hide the view counter on specific products?

Free: Yes for styling, no for conditional display. You can fully customize the appearance (colors, fonts, size, position, even make it transparent), but the counter will render on all products once enabled. You can make it visually invisible with 100% transparency, but it still outputs the HTML.

Pro: Full control. Hide or show counters per-product with a simple checkbox in the product edit screen. Useful for:
– Hiding counters on low-traffic products
– Only showing on bestsellers
– Excluding sale/clearance items
– Custom display rules for different product categories

Upgrade to Pro for conditional display →

What’s the difference between free and Pro?

Free = view counter + basic analytics
Pro = AI forecasting, padding, alerts, exports

Works with caching plugins?

Yes — compatible with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, SiteGround Speed Optimizer, and other major caching solutions. View tracking runs async and bypasses cache.

Does it work without cookies or with strict privacy settings?

The plugin uses cookies to prevent duplicate view counts within a cooldown period. It also uses IP addresses for whitelist functionality. View tracking may be affected if users block cookies, but the plugin is designed to work in most scenarios.

Is it GDPR / EU privacy compliant?

The plugin is designed to be GDPR-compliant. All product view tracking data stays in your local WordPress database. No external servers are used for tracking. The plugin uses cookies to prevent duplicate counts and may use IP addresses for whitelist checking. However, you should review your specific privacy requirements and ensure compliance with applicable regulations, including cookie consent requirements where applicable.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No. The plugin features an intuitive dashboard and simple setup. Advanced users can customize styling and settings, but it works out of the box.
